page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.6xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance provides 24 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, resulting in 24 vCPUs. It is equipped with 96.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory allocation of 4.0 GB per core.

A defining characteristic of this server is its local storage capacity. The instance includes 70,866 GB of local HDD storage, making it suitable for massive data retention and sequential storage tasks. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 8 Gbps. There are no complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this instance, and it does not feature any GPU acceleration.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.d1.6xlarge offers high storage density per resource unit, trading off the high random IOPS of SSDs for massive, cost-effective HDD capacity. This hardware profile is suited for workloads requiring large-scale data storage, such as distributed file systems, big data analytics, data warehousing, and cold storage archives.
